title: Sampling Hyperparameters & Prompt Engineering
description: Master generation controls: Temperature, Top-p (Nucleus), Top-k. Master Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought prompting.

slides.title: Controlling Generation: Decoding Parameters 🎛️
slides.content:
# Sampling Hyperparameters

LLMs output probability distributions over vocabulary tokens. Decoding parameters dictate how the next token is chosen:

| Parameter | Mathematical Mechanism | High Value Effect | Low Value Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Temperature ($T$)** | Divides raw logits before Softmax: $\frac{z_i}{T}$ | Flattened probabilities: creative, diverse, hallucinatory | Sharpened distribution: deterministic, focused, logical |
| **Top-p (Nucleus)** | Truncates pool to smallest set whose cumulative prob $\ge p$ | Broader candidate pool when confidence is low | Restricts choices strictly to top probability mass |
| **Top-k** | Keeps strictly top $k$ highest probability tokens | Broader word choices | Limits candidates to top $k$ tokens (e.g. $k=40$) |

For factual coding and JSON extraction, set $T=0.0$; for creative brainstorming, set $T=0.7 - 0.9$.

slides.title: Modern Prompting Strategies 📝
slides.content:
# The Art of Prompt Engineering

| Prompting Pattern | Description | Best Application |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Zero-Shot** | Direct task request without prior demonstrations | Simple queries, standard summarization |
| **Few-Shot (In-Context Learning)**| Providing 2-5 explicit input/output examples before query | Formatting enforcement, custom classification schema |
| **Chain-of-Thought (CoT)** | "Think step-by-step before producing final answer" | Complex multi-step arithmetic, logic puzzles, symbolic deduction |
| **ReAct (Reason + Act)** | Interleaving thought, action tool call, and observation | Autonomous agentic tasks requiring external APIs |

quizData.question: Which temperature setting should be selected when using an LLM to parse financial invoices into strict, deterministic JSON schemas?
quizData.explanation: Temperature 0.0 enforces greedy decoding, selecting the highest-probability token deterministically and minimizing formatting errors.

slides.title: Structured Few-Shot Prompting in Python 🐍
slides.content: Crafting a robust few-shot prompt for reliable entity extraction:
slides.codeSnippet:
prompt = '''Extract the person and location in JSON format:

Input: 'Steve Jobs founded Apple in Los Altos.'
Output: {"person": "Steve Jobs", "location": "Los Altos"}

Input: 'Ada Lovelace wrote the first computer program in London.'
Output: {"person": "Ada Lovelace", "location": "London"}

Input: 'Guido van Rossum released Python while working in Amsterdam.'
Output:'''

print(prompt)
